problems.stem: What is the main function of owl-inspired trailing-edge serrations on a drone blade?
options: To soften and redistribute vortex formation at the trailing edge
To completely remove drag from the blade
To make the blade heavier so it vibrates less
problems.explanation: Trailing-edge serrations alter how vortices form and mix, which can reduce noise generation.

The relationship between battery chemistry and rotor torque
The relationship between wing color and lift
The relationship between payload mass and GPS accuracy
problems.explanation: Aeroacoustics studies how aerodynamic forces and unsteady flow structures generate noise.

problems.stem: Why can micro-serrations make drone noise less noticeable to humans?
options: Because they convert all turbulence into laminar flow instantly
Because they can break larger coherent structures into smaller and less synchronized disturbances
Because they prevent the rotor from spinning above idle speed
Because they eliminate pressure differences across the blade
problems.explanation: Smaller, less synchronized structures can reduce strong coherent noise signatures and shift the acoustic profile.

problems.stem: Which engineering decision best reflects owl-wing biomimicry?
options: Add literal feathers to the propeller
Modify edge geometry to control flow and acoustic output
Increase blade thickness everywhere without analysis
Ignore vortex behavior and focus only on paint color
problems.explanation: Biomimicry abstracts the geometric principle behind the biological effect rather than copying the organism literally.
